text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaaa! That's one crown down! 
Congratulatiooooons!!" Oakley/Crown 
context

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...! The voices are making the 
air tingle. So this is a Classic race...!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing that just makes me want you to 
cheer even louder.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm so glad I won! Thank you so 
much, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ghk! W-What a straightforward greeting...! 
Aaand, such an untainted smile...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a fantastic burst of speed. 
There's no doubt Buena Vista is the 
absolute favorite for this year's Tiara 
route!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Impressive as always, Buena-san. 
Standing at the center of the applause 
suits you so well."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: —That is why it has to be you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If it can be overcome... it would be 
nothing short of a miracle. Therefore, 
"that place" awaits beyond this point...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaah...! Buena Viiiiiistaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. This attention... with all 
due humility, I wonder if I might bask in 
its favor?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Buena Vista is victorious!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations, you never fail to 
impress!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The atmosphere of a Classic race really 
is something special...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Everyone's smiles, their 
voices... All of it was sparkling so 
brightly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If I could move the hearts of even more 
people with my victories... What a 
wonderful sight that would be.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain of it. There's a breathtaking 
view waiting just up ahead!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's keep pushing forward like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race, we held a press 
conference. First, after receiving 
everyone's congratulations on Buena 
Vista's victory—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Regarding our future outlook, is the 
Oaks... really the right choice?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
In recent years, Miss Vodka conquered the 
Japanese Derby, paving a new path for 
strong Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista-san put on a wonderful 
performance today as well. Do you have 
plans to aim for the top of this 
generation?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your expectations! However, 
this is the path I will follow.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I will win the Oaks and stand at the 
pinnacle of the Tiara route!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm really looking forward to... 
taking in the wonderful scenery there now.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A question for you, Trainer! The Oaks 
is held at Tokyo Racecourse over 2,400 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The distance will increase significantly 
from today's 1600m; how are you keeping 
that in mind?
choice_data_list:
Moving up in distance won't be a problem 
at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list:
She has the legs to close from anywhere 
and take the lead, after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what confidence! Coming from someone 
who has watched closely by their side, it 
must be true.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"...Judging from Buena-san's running 
today, there's still plenty of room to 
polish her skills, and she'll likely grow 
even further under Trainer-san's 
guidance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I notice that the reporter's tone has 
changed to a friendlier one compared to 
before. Could it be that they're starting 
to acknowledge me too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Well then, is there anything else—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
—Can you see it? The world you are 
destined to reach?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Pardon the interruption. It will only 
take a moment, so please forgive me."

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
Red Desire...!? Coming all the way here... 
What happened...?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Now then... Everyone. Have you ever felt 
that there is a world far better suited 
for you?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I have. —And one day, I received a 
revelation.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: A spotlight!? Where from...!?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to share a very special secret 
with you all.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Truth is... I am a Saint.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yet whether by the inevitable pull of 
fate... or perhaps a cruel twist of 
mischief... I descended into the wrong 
world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
However, strangely enough, I understood 
immediately—that this was a trial bestowed 
upon me.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Once I overcome that and prove myself a 
saint— I will finally reach 'that place.'"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: And, that very ordeal is—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: "Buena-san. It is to—surpass you."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...! I'm... a trial?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive my selfishness. However... 
destiny has already decided.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"If I can overcome you, I'll be able to 
reach the realm I aspire to... I look 
forward to racing you in the Oaks as 
well."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Desire-chan... ...Yeah, looking forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...I don't really get it all, but the Oaks 
is going to be one fiery battle...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Heroine vs. Saint, who will emerge 
victorious!?" ...Fascinating. This is sure 
to be thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The storm brought by Red Desire seemed to 
have stoked the reporters' enthusiasm. I 
can feel the expectations accelerating...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's already a deeply sensitive girl. If 
she gets any more worked up... she might 
end up putting way too much pressure on 
herself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that in mind, I called out to warn 
them, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Are you completely fine?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I felt a tiny bit of tension, yeah. But 
still...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You'll give me a chance to catch my 
breath, won't you? Taking that into 
account... it'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... we'll need to brace 
ourselves and focus even harder for the 
Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Because it might block the path to the 
world Desire-chan wishes for.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Going to a whole different world is a 
really difficult thing, I think. If I win, 
I'll be taking away that chance.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
“The victor always bears responsibility. I 
know that, but... it really is awfully 
heavy.”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that doesn't mean... I can just 
hand over the victory. I have to face this 
head-on."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if Desire-chan's world is 
really that far away after all."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...*sniffle*. You have it rough, 
Desire-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While managing to persuade the pure Buena 
Vista... the challenge of the Yushun Himba 
begins.
